structural_change: SAFE-HBM-DBK 10-21 (H.STA.BLK.12): WA-LANDED successor after daemon routes hv16_dbk_cpl_o1-o1-bc6e7ea9f (MAIN) and hv16_dbk_cpl_o1b-o1b-4929d4bc5 (FB) stopped at FLOORPLAN_MARGIN bank_distance: the centre controller u_dbk.u_control (259.2..328.3 sq) was the last child still wired straight to block pins: wa[11:0] + wb_ready (N face x 426-430) + clk/stk[1:0] (E), centroid (436,513) 216.9 um away. The outline is the exact die sub-slot and the N row is banks L5-L7, so the controller cannot reach the N face; moving wa/wb_ready pins above the controller still leaves 173 um. Structural fix (new master ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks_cplw): wa + wb_ready land in a kept N-face register on clk_out[3] (the N E-half root that already carries wb_reserve/wb_fill, beside the wb ports); u_control keeps only clk + stk[1:0] straight (3 < bank_min_pins 8). Cycles to the die: wa/wb_ready +1 edge into the controller (ack later is safe; wb_ready is the static first-drain check, die holds it one edge earlier); every other port = _cplo. Geometry, pins, roots unchanged from o1. job.purpose: HBM die d4g hb_dbk_<q> x4 (per quadrant, master unchanged; F20 tgt 104+QID: SW 104 / SE 105 / NW 106 / NE 107; RBH-STK). Measured reasons (hv15_dbk_cp gate 1f18141cb, 10-16): clk_cp 1,844 sinks TT 421.6 / spread 126.5 (collar flops smeared between the 8 banks), rst_n port -> 793 loads unregistered incl. 8 bank macros + controller (in->macro -296.1), in->reg -170.8 u_cp.cmd[26] with the W face 98% pin-full; children off the 43.2 um lattice; 645.84 x 360.72 (1.79:1).  Why not the d4f slot 560 x 400: on the 43.2 um child lattice three 87.48-um bank rows need y = 43.2/172.8/302.4 (top 389.9, no N channel left in 400) and three 140.4-um columns need x up to 529.2, so 560 x 400 holds at most 2 x 3 = 6 banks; 8 banks + controller + collar leaf = 10 objects, and every bank must stay within ~480 um of BOTH the W face (rr) and the N face (wd) (textbook wire_reach 500 um/stage).  A 3-row ring (controller centre) cannot take the leaf within 1.5:1 (width >= 712 at height 432).  Chosen: 4 rows x 3 columns, 604.8 x 540 (1.12:1):   * col0 (x 86.4, 4 banks; 86.4 um W channel carries their 1,156 wd bits N), col1/col2 (x 259.2/432) banks in rows 0     and 3; the controller in col1 between rows 1-2 (bank star <= ~430 um), the collar leaf in col2 between rows 1-2     (W face -> controller E face 104 um; E face 21.6 um from the cluster E face where the F20 host bus enters);   * channels >= 32.4 um (columns) / 42.1 um (rows), every child on the 43.2 lattice;   * W face: rr per bank row (rq + rr_valid beside the controller row), <= 4.6 pins/um; N face: wd per bank column + wb/wa,     <= 4.5 pins/um; each clk_bank entry on the face point nearest its bank clock pin; clk_cp at the leaf clock pin.
